newsitem.title: USA: Clinton praises House vote on China MFN.
newsitem.headline: Clinton praises House vote on China MFN.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton praised the House of Representatives vote on Tuesday maintaining normal U.S. trade relations with China, saying it was "a vote for America's interests."
The House, in a vote of 259 to 173, rejected a measure that would have overturned Clinton's decision to extend for one year most favoured nation trade status with China.

"It sends a clear signal to our friends and foes alike that when it comes to America's security and prosperity, our nation speaks with one voice," Clinton said in a statement issued by the White House.
"Today's vote was a vote for America's interests," Clinton said. "It make clear that the right way to encourage further progress in China is not to cut China off but to draw China in."
